It took eight upstream blitz commits by cherry-pick, the lockfile the only conflict in each, and with them Taffy #1303: the engine's inline layout pass now hands Taffy a caller-defined float id when it places a floated box.
The eight commits' layout changes reach every document's float placement; the founder ratified them for this take (F2), on the condition that the gates, the stand, the a11y leg and CI are green, and all held.
Every test tally stayed equal to the base: the workspace tests, the embolden check, the a11y leg (14 binaries, 115 tests) and the stand (294 passed), with the stand repeated three of three rounds green.
Upstream's later Taffy chain from #1372 (reversed scroll origins and its five later bumps) was left out by design and waits for its own route entry.
No accessibility code, ARIA reading, accessibility tree builder, snapshot reader or contrast check was edited; no capability was added or retired.

the engine DOM's inline layout pass, where floated boxes are placed through Taffy; its one float placement call now passes the node's own id as the float id

body:
The session moved the Taffy layout engine dependency from the crates.io registry version 0.15.1, with its checksum, to upstream's git repository pinned at the full commit rev e90751fd (package version 0.15.0, licence MIT, rust-version 1.71), its features and dependency list unchanged.
Taffy is now the workspace's one git source (the git-source count moved 0 to 1), with no patch section; no other package moved, parley unmoved.
The content came by no-commit cherry-pick of eight upstream blitz commits, the lock file the only conflict in each, re-resolved; the later Taffy chain from #1372 on (reversed scroll origins and five later bumps) was left out by design for its own later route entry.
The one call of Taffy's float placement in blitz-dom's inline layout now passes a caller-defined float id (Taffy #1303); no public symbol, crate, schema, config, harness or gate changed.
The founder ratified the eight commits' layout changes for every document; the gates, stand, a11y leg and CI all ran green, the audit leg reading advisories ok and licenses ok, and no test tally moved.

body_fields.what: the root workspace manifest, holding the engine dependency pins and the workspace-inherited dependency versions; its taffy line now names the git repository at rev e90751fd in place of a registry version

the lockfile behind locked builds and the audit leg; the taffy package now carries a git source at e90751fd and no checksum line, the lock's only git source; the conflict in each cherry-pick was resolved here
blitz-dom's inline layout pass, the one caller of Taffy's float placement, now passing a caller-defined float id

body: decision/engine-dependency-pins: Taffy is no longer pinned as a crates.io registry 0.15 version; it is pinned to upstream git at rev e90751fd, package version 0.15.0.

decision/no-git-dependencies: its statement that taffy and parley are crates.io registry versions with checksums is stale for taffy; taffy is now a git dependency with no lock checksum, under the Taffy-only exception; parley unmoved. Its verified evidence cites lock lines that moved (the taffy version and source now at lines 8041-8042, the checksum line gone, later lines up one).
decision/no-git-dependency: the workspace now holds exactly one git dependency, taffy; a row saying no git dependency exists is broken unless it carries the Taffy exception.

decision/upstream-sync-dependency-set: the upstream take moved the taffy package alone in the lock, and its git source is the Taffy exception's own subject; the set was taken through eight cherry-picks with the lock re-resolved, not whole.
decision/locked-builds: the lock's taffy entry is now a git source resolved by rev with no checksum; locked builds and the audit leg ran green over it.

decision/licence-gate and decision/dependency-audit-ci-gate and decision/cargo-deny-audit-tool: the audit leg now reads a git-sourced crate (MIT) inside cargo-deny's resolved graph; it passed with advisories ok and licenses ok.
decision/workspace-inherited-dependency-versions: the taffy workspace dependency is now inherited as a git rev pin rather than a registry version.

absence/automated-dependency-updates: the bump was manual and the deferred later Taffy chain waits for its own route entry; no update tooling was added, so the absence stands but its context (a manual git pin to move) changed.
dependency-security overview: its note that the lockfile's advisory state is read within cargo-deny's resolved graph now covers one git source.

decision/inline-box-heights-finite and other inline-layout rules: indirectly, through blitz-dom's inline layout pass, whose float placement now passes a caller-defined float id and whose layout behaviour moved with the eight ratified upstream commits.

body_fields.fact: Taffy is the workspace's one git dependency, pinned to upstream DioxusLabs/taffy at the full commit rev e90751fd with no patch section; its lock entry carries no checksum, so its integrity rests on the commit rev pin, and every other dependency stays a crates.io registry version with a checksum.

body: The driver session socket, the MCP server and their contracts (request lines, replies, refusals, exit codes, tool results) are untouched: no verb, wire form or bound moved.
Authentication and authorization rows, CI tokens and publish guards, and secret management rows are untouched: no workflow, secret or environment variable changed.
Data protection rows (history database, HTTP cache, cookies, kept check files, recording directories) are untouched.
Logging and monitoring rows, the telemetry sink allowlist and span contracts are untouched: no log target or field moved.
Outbound request controls (blitz-net, per-host limits, GET-only sub-resources, CORS and same-origin absences, external navigation schemes) and script fetcher rows are untouched.
Select list, password masking, stable element id, snapshot and accessibility rows are untouched: no control, carrier or reader changed.
CI action SHA pinning, signing material and the coverage floors are untouched; no test was added and no tally moved.

The layout engine Taffy moved from the crates.io registry version 0.15.1 to upstream Taffy's git source at rev e90751fd (package version 0.15.0, rust-version 1.71, licence MIT, no checksum line), the lock's one git source.
Eight upstream blitz commits were taken by no-commit cherry-pick, the lock the only conflict in each; their layout changes reach every document and land ratified by the founder, not provisional.
The inline layout pass now hands Taffy's float placement a caller-defined float id (Taffy #1303), its one call of that function changed by one line; no public symbol, crate, schema, config or gate surface changed.
Measured: the fast leg, the stand, stand-repeat 3 of 3, a11y, msrv, audit, doc, build, counter and wasm legs green, the smoke up 10 s, and CI 17 of 17 green across the native platforms; every test tally equal to the base's (test 239 · 1464 · 0 · 13, embolden 6, a11y 14 · 115, stand 294 · 0 · 8).
Left out by design for a later entry: Taffy from #1372 on (reversed scroll origins and the five later bumps), which leaves blitz-dom uncompiled.

body_fields.what: the workspace manifest — the engine dependency list and its version pins; edited, the taffy line now a git dependency at rev e90751fd
the dependency lock the locked cargo legs and the dependency audit read; edited, the taffy package now a git source with no checksum, the conflict of each upstream pick resolved in it
blitz-dom's inline layout pass — float placement through Taffy's place_floated_box; edited by the cherry-picked upstream commit to pass the float id

body: decision/incremental-differential-oracle — the eight taken commits change layout for every document and the float placement call changed; the incremental layout oracle ran in the workspace run and stayed green.

decision/layout-tests-in-both-layout-modes and decision/stand-checks-in-both-layout-modes — the inline layout pass's float placement changed; the layout assertions and stand checks ran green with their counts unmoved.
decision/workspace-tests-in-fast-ci-leg — the fast leg ran the changed layout path: 239 · 1464 · 0 · 13, equal to the base.
decision/tally-move-attributed-by-test-name — no tally moved in any leg, so no move is owed an attribution by test name.

decision/stand-repeat-three-rounds, decision/zero-failure-stand-repeat and decision/stand-checks-zero-failure-budget — stand-repeat 3 of 3 rounds green, the stand 294 · 0 · 8; the zero-failure budget held.
decision/msrv-1-91 and decision/msrv-verified-by-build — the git Taffy declares rust-version 1.71, below the workspace minimum; the msrv leg built green and the minimum stands.
decision/dependency-audit-advisories-and-licenses — the lock now holds one git source (taffy, MIT, no checksum); the audit leg read advisories ok, licenses ok.
decision/cargo-legs-locked — the lock moved five lines and gained a git source re-resolved by cargo metadata; every locked cargo leg ran green on it.

decision/ci-shared-test-cache, decision/shared-test-cache and decision/ci-rust-cache — the lock the cache reads moved and a git checkout of Taffy joins the build; indirect, through the dependency change.
decision/native-platform-ci-matrix — CI 17 of 17 green on the pushed head, the macOS, windows, android and ios test jobs among them.
decision/a11y-leg-membership — the a11y leg ran green at 14 · 115, unmoved; its membership unchanged.
decision/embolden-local-witness and decision/embolden-leg-local-only — the embolden witness leg ran at 6, unmoved, over a changed layout engine.
decision/clippy-legs and decision/blitz-dom-fixtures-built-manually — blitz-dom changed by one line in its inline layout pass; its lint and its manually built fixtures ran unchanged.

decision/per-crate-coverage-floors, decision/coverage-floor-per-crate and decision/coverage-leg-exits-with-floor — blitz-dom's code changed by one line; the coverage leg was not among this run's gates, so a blitz-dom floor a row holds was not re-read.

decision/wpt-conformance-report-only, decision/fork-wpt-reading-report-only and decision/wpt-conformance-runner — the layout changes for every document may move WPT readings; no WPT reading was taken this run, the reading report-only.
decision/local-pre-push-gate and decision/local-baseline — the local gate ran green before the push and its tallies are the baseline CI was read against.
decision/regression-tests-document-bug and decision/regression-tests-named-for-bug — the Taffy #1303 float id came with no new test; its presence is held by a gate entry, not a committed test.
The session wire, session host, session errors, session recording and session state contracts of the session lifecycle: no session code, protocol or bound moved.
The escher-session command line, MCP role and CLI contracts (exit codes, help, snapshot budget, tools list, refusals): no command, answer or exit code changed.
The driver session, driver verbs, refusal causes and handler coverage rows: no verb, cause or coverage reading changed.
The cold-agent pipe rows and the agent-run contract (verbs, selections, events, exit codes): run as before, unchanged.
The harness construction, core, input, inspection, settle, contrast and screenshot contracts and the virtual clock: no harness API moved.
The mocking and stubbing discipline, the stand's timer and load stand-ins and the test data and fixtures rows: no stand-in, fixture or committed check changed.

The CI workflow's own rules — actions pinned to SHAs, read-only permissions, no secrets, triggers, fast/slow split, bounded package installs and their exit codes, the leg script: no workflow or script changed.
decision/scrolled-box-reads-where-it-stands and the scrollbar rows: the reversed scroll origins of Taffy #1372 were left out, so scrolled-box reading is unchanged.
The mutation testing, complexity ceiling and keyboard_compat coverage exclusion rows, and absence/windowed-end-to-end-tests: the smoke is a gate entry, no committed windowed test.
